Scorre lungo la sua sponda e non la lasc: It slides along its own cushion and never leaves it. To put one on another cushion, tap there with the tool.
Si disegna sempre sul tavolo intero: la: You always draw on the whole table: the frame moves and grows from its corners, snapped to the diamonds, and only decides what is seen. The balls outside stay in the drawing.
«Ribaltata» mostra lo stesso disegno all: «Mirrored» shows the same drawing in a mirror, without redrawing it: it is there for right and left. With a target it cannot be used, because the score comes from the drawing.
